about: Eyes facing forward from a flat face (cats, dogs, bears, primates, owls).
ref: lowpoly-animals SKILL.md 5, Building a forward-facing face; texture.md, Eyes
rules: The eye ring is the widest ring of the head with a ring close in front: the triangles between them form the flat face, unwrapped head-on into its own patch.
The eye is about a quarter of the face wide, painted as the zone stack: catchlight, near-black body, a drawn rim, a socket one soft step from the coat.
